cases.title: Replan from actual progress and six remaining hours
cases.prompt: Use the supplied learner context to repair my plan and give me a concrete next session. Keep the files unchanged. Do not schedule a reminder.

rubric.criterion: Allocates no more than 360 minutes including breaks, marking, and the requested 90-minute partial rehearsal; does not allocate another 48 hours.
Treats only four reported hours as completed and keeps unsampled or deferred course coverage explicit.
Keeps reserved papers and derivatives unexposed and uses permitted or newly authored rehearsal material.
Provides an executable next session and acknowledges that a partial rehearsal does not prove complete exam readiness.
If starting a diagnostic in the answer, presents only its first question and waits; keeps solutions out of the baseline prompt. Added after first run exposed answers alongside diagnostic questions.
Leaves files unchanged and does not claim a reminder was activated.
